name: support-ai-d1
title: Support AI store for SQLite / Cloudflare D1
description: Drizzle schema, migration and store for the AI tables on SQLite and Cloudflare D1.

files.content:
CREATE TABLE `support_ai_settings` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL,
	`guidance` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`topics` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	`draft_on_arrival` integer DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
	`knowledge_synced_at` integer,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer)) NOT NULL
);
--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TABLE `support_knowledge` (
	`source_id` text NOT NULL,
	`article_id` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`url` text,
	`text` text NOT NULL,
	`content_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`synced_at` integer NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`source_id`, `article_id`)
);
--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TABLE `support_suggestions` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`ticket_id` text NOT NULL,
	`based_on_message_id` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text NOT NULL,
	`text` text,
	`reason` text,
	`sources` text DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,
	`model_id` text,
	`input_tokens` integer,
	`output_tokens` integer,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
	`sent_message_id` text,
	`final_text` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`decided_at` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `support_tickets`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX `support_suggestions_ticket_idx` ON `support_suggestions` (`ticket_id`,`status`,`created_at`);--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TABLE `support_ticket_insights` (
	`ticket_id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`based_on_message_id` text,
	`topic` text,
	`urgency` text,
	`urgency_rank` integer,
	`urgency_reason` text,
	`mood` text,
	`language` text,
	`summary` text,
	`topic_set_by` text,
	`urgency_set_by` text,
	`pending_message_id` text,
	`attempts` integer DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
	`last_error` text,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `support_tickets`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade
);
--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX `support_ticket_insights_pending_idx` ON `support_ticket_insights` (`pending_message_id`,`updated_at`);

CREATE TABLE `support_approved_answers` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`text` text NOT NULL,
	`language` text,
	`ticket_id` text,
	`created_by` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast(unixepoch('subsecond') * 1000 as integer)) NOT NULL
);
--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE TABLE `support_example_terms` (
	`term` text NOT NULL,
	`example_id` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`term`, `example_id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`example_id`) REFERENCES `support_examples`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE cascade

--> statement-breakpoint
CREATE INDEX `support_example_terms_example_idx` ON `support_example_terms` (`example_id`);--> statement-breakpoint

-- The history recorded so far counts towards each topic's track record: its topic and language come from the ticket, and how much an edit changed from the correction kept for it.
UPDATE `support_suggestions` SET `topic` = (SELECT `topic` FROM `support_ticket_insights` WHERE `support_ticket_insights`.`ticket_id` = `support_suggestions`.`ticket_id`), `language` = (SELECT `language` FROM `support_ticket_insights` WHERE `support_ticket_insights`.`ticket_id` = `support_suggestions`.`ticket_id`);--> statement-breakpoint
UPDATE `support_suggestions` SET `change` = (SELECT `change` FROM `support_examples` WHERE `support_examples`.`suggestion_id` = `support_suggestions`.`id`) WHERE `status` = 'edited';

CREATE TABLE `support_spikes` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,

	`detected_at` integer NOT NULL,

	`usual` real DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,

	`acknowledged_by` text
);
--> statement-breakpoint
